Note: Before you can add a new user (and specify environment-specific access for that new user) in the Apigee UI, you must grant that user access to the Google Cloud project, as described in Managing access in Google Cloud .

supporting_pages.title: Managing access in Google Cloud \_|\_ Apigee \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Note: When you add new users to your project in the Google Cloud console, the new user can by default access all environments in the organization.
To add a user and assign Apigee roles to it in your Google Cloud project: In the Google Cloud console, go to the IAM & Admin > IAM page.
You do this by using the IAM service in the Google Cloud console.
